hypotheses.reasoning: redis-cache restarted after a node replacement with no snapshot and 0 keys (#2228). Search-api's cache miss ratio then hit 96% against a 3% baseline, so reads fell through to catalog-db (#2372). That is a cache stampede. catalog-db hit 485/500 connections and 96% CPU (#2317), and its queries slowed (#2414). Search-api queries timed out (#2410), and web-bff returned 504s. The notif-worker poison message crash loop (#2051) is unrelated, because it affects a different service chain. The metrics-agent errors are only a side effect.
catalog-db slow queries causing search-api timeouts would fit this category if the cache cold start were ignored.

verdict.recommendedAction: Warm the cache and rate-limit or coalesce cache-miss loads to catalog-db. Consider adding a connection limit on the search path. Make redis-cache persistent (RDB snapshot) or add replicas so a node replacement doesn't start cold. Separately, fix the notif-worker expandReferences stack overflow and skip msg-759587 at offset 829709.
